name: kiao-style
description: KIAO design system - Dark theme CSS with design tokens

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:ts
scripts.build:css: postcss src/kiao-dark.css -o dist/kiao-dark.css && postcss src/kiao-light.css -o dist/kiao-light.css && postcss src/kiao-sober-dark.css -o dist/kiao-sober-dark.css && postcss src/kiao-sober-light.css -o dist/kiao-sober-light.css && postcss src/style-tools.css -o dist/style-tools.css
scripts.dev: postcss src/kiao-dark.css -o dist/kiao-dark.css & postcss src/kiao-light.css -o dist/kiao-light.css & postcss src/kiao-sober-dark.css -o dist/kiao-sober-dark.css & postcss src/kiao-sober-light.css -o dist/kiao-sober-light.css & postcss src/style-tools.css -o dist/style-tools.css --watch
